title: LanguageMetaGenomeV0
description: Machine-checkable form of manual §10.1's canonical object, with the gene families of §10.2-§10.9 and the §11 cross-field constraints that a JSON Schema can carry. The meta-genome defines the generative search space; it does not enumerate the mathematical-language universe (§10).
$comment: AUTHORITY: manual §10, §11. WHAT THIS SCHEMA CANNOT ENFORCE, and which therefore MUST be code-enforced and MUST fail as DEAD_GENOME_CONSTRAINT (§11, §12.4) before any Solver compute is spent (§12.4 'No dead candidate receives Solver compute'): (1) that a declared derivation_algorithm, index_assignment_procedure, node_identity_procedure, morpheme_grammar_ref or state_delta_validator_ref is DETERMINISTIC - schema can require the declaration, never its semantics; (2) that an executable grammar actually emits a machine-readable grammar/validator (§10.6); (3) that an ontology concept set to ABSENT is genuinely deterministically derivable from what remains; (4) that a projection feature's admissibility flags are truthful, i.e. that it really does not read an answer label, a future state, a hidden solution, a minimum proof path, or a candidate-correctness label (§27 - a P3 feature is forbidden in candidate input and is DEAD_LEAKAGE, §12.4); (5) that the renderer for a declared grammar family exists rather than silently aliasing another family - the repository has measured this exact failure, two seed surfaces sharing 98.6% of state bytes (docs/PHASE8_SALVAGE_HANDOFF.md §3.2). DIVERGENCE FROM docs/LANGUAGE_META_GENOME_V0.md: that document adds families W (workspace) and tau (tokenizer) as first-class containers; manual §10.1 has neither, placing candidate-specific tokenizer training in §10.10 deferred_features. The manual wins (§3.1). This schema therefore carries W and tau only inside deferred_features. Ontology gene DOMAIN: §10.2 requires only that each concept be 'optional/searchable'; the four-valued ordinal below is imported from docs/LANGUAGE_META_GENOME_V0.md §3.1 as an ENGINEERING_DECISION that refines optionality (ABSENT satisfies it) rather than contradicting it. VERSIONING: §11 - the meta-genome MUST be versioned, and a change to this schema requires an ADR, a new schema version, and a migration policy (§44.2). INTERVENTION CLASS is NOT a genome field: it belongs to LanguageCandidate (§12.1) because it types a COMPARISON, not a genome.

ontology_presence.description: §10.2. ABSENT is legal only if the concept is deterministically derivable from what remains (code-enforced).

projection_feature.description: §10.3: every projection feature MUST declare a deterministic derivation procedure and an admissibility audit. Field set is §27 verbatim.

projection_class.description: §27. P0 direct relations; P1 local deterministic structure; P2 bounded derived summaries; P3 solution-dependent/future-dependent and FORBIDDEN in candidate input.

then.$comment: §27: P3 is forbidden in candidate input.

ontology.description: §10.2 O. Each concept SHALL be optional/searchable unless kernel requirements force otherwise. V0 SHALL NOT declare every concept mandatory.

node_identity_procedure.description: §11: GRAPH topology requires deterministic node identity. Required by the allOf constraint below for GRAPH and HYPERGRAPH.

index_assignment_procedure.description: §11: INDEXED binders require a renderer capable of deterministic index assignment.

grammar.description: §10.6 G. 'Each executable grammar MUST emit a machine-readable grammar/validator' - the reference is required here; its existence and correctness are code-enforced.

morphology.description: §10.7 M. ARBITRARY_ATOMIC_SYMBOLS is a CONTROL family (§9): random symbol substitution with no other compositional or structural change is an encryption/permutation control for pretrained lexical familiarity, not a language discovery.

morpheme_grammar_ref.description: §11: COMPOSITIONAL_SYMBOLIC morphology requires a declared morpheme grammar.

action_protocol.description: §10.8 A. §13.2: the finest primitive decomposition is NOT presumed optimal. §13.1: a macro does not receive free compute; kernel_step_count is accounted after lowering.

interface.description: §10.9 I. Dimensions are §10.9 verbatim; their value domains are DELEGATED_FREEDOM (§37) within the declared constraints, because §10.9 lists dimensions rather than enums.

deferred_features.description: §10.10. All SHALL be disabled in the first causal search unless explicitly activated by a later ADR. Each is const false here so that activation is a schema change requiring an ADR (§44.2), not a value change.

allOf.$comment: §11: GRAPH topology requires deterministic node identity. Schema requires the DECLARATION; determinism is code-enforced.
§11: INDEXED binders require a renderer capable of deterministic index assignment.

§11: COMPOSITIONAL_SYMBOLIC morphology requires a declared morpheme grammar. INVENTED_MORPHEMES is included because §9 makes internal composition the property that distinguishes a candidate morphology from a permutation control.
